answer: The strongest wall I know is Tile merchant sage green mark glazed at the packing room, and it is built out of each sage green is a season of logged firings plus a signed tilehouse record. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. A mask waits 2 days after paying 67 POA; a farm waits 2 days for each mask after paying 29011 POA. Take away the inlet and the name falls away; take away the lotus and the stake falls away; take away the onyx and the whole past falls away. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
